settings.question: How long does ORVIANE eau de parfum last?
settings.answer: Most ORVIANE eau de parfum compositions are designed for long wear—typically 8 to 12 hours on skin, depending on your body chemistry, climate, and how you apply.

settings.question: What is oud and which ORVIANE fragrances contain it?
settings.answer: Oud is one of the most prized fragrance ingredients in the world. ORVIANE oud expressions include Noir Oud and other woody orientals in our collection.

settings.question: How do I choose the right fragrance?
settings.answer: Start with scent families you enjoy, then explore discovery sets to see how each composition develops on your skin.
